messages:
Aisha Patel: Hi team — first week here! Trying to set up Grafana and Sentry. I followed the onboarding doc but Grafana panels 404 when I try to open a dashboard link from the playbook. Anyone know who handles dashboard sharing?
Maya (devex): welcome Aisha! :tada: Which dashboard link are you clicking? Is it the shared ‘prod-overview’ one or a team-specific panel?
Aisha Patel: It was the prod-overview link from the onboarding checklist: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd1234/prod-overview. It errors with 404. I can access other folders though.
Samir (obs-eng): that usually means the dashboard is in a restricted folder or the dashboard uid changed after a re-import. Can you paste the exact URL and your user email?
Aisha Patel: url above, email aisha@redwood.ai. Also saw a note in the playbook about using the Grafana group `redwood-observability-viewers` — I don’t see that in my groups.
Maya (devex): ok, I’ll ping infra to check group membership. @DevEx Bot can you create a ticket for Grafana access for Aisha?
DevEx Bot: Created ticket #DX-3241 — "Grafana access: add aisha@redwood.ai to redwood-observability-viewers". Assignee: Maya. ETA: 1 business day.
Samir (obs-eng): in the meantime, you can open the dashboard via the folder path: Grafana Home > Dashboards > Browse > Production > Prod Overview. If you hit 403/404 let us know.
Aisha Patel: thanks — FYI I tried via Browse and it showed the dashboard briefly then 404 when opening a panel.
Maya (devex): sounds like a UID mismatch. Samir, could the dashboard have been reimported under a new UID during the migration last week?
Samir (obs-eng): yeah probable. I’ll check the import history. If UID changed, I’ll add a redirect or update the playbook link.
Aisha Patel: quick Sentry question too — when I log in I don’t see the `redwood-team` org projects (only my personal sandbox). Who to add me to Sentry projects?
Maya (devex): that's usually on the security side but we can help. @DevEx Bot can you attach Sentry onboarding checklist to ticket #DX-3241?
DevEx Bot: Attached docs: /playbooks/observability/sentry_onboarding.md to #DX-3241.
Samir (obs-eng): for Sentry send me the project slugs you need and I’ll add you to project-level roles. Typical flow: add to org team -> grant project access.
Aisha Patel: thanks! Could you add me to teams: `platform`, `frontend`, and project slugs `frontend-web`, `api-prod`?
Samir (obs-eng): noted. I’ll add you to org teams and update ticket. Expect Sentry access in a few hours.
Maya (devex): ETA updates in #DX-3241. Aisha — if anything blocks your onboarding flows (alerts, runbooks) ping me directly and I’ll escalate.
Aisha Patel: awesome, really appreciate it :heart:
Samir (obs-eng): follow-up: found that prod-overview UID changed during the Grafana export last Tuesday. I updated redirects and refreshed the playbook link. Try the original URL again and clear cache if needed.
Aisha Patel: tried it — working now! Panels load and Sentry projects are visible too. Thank you both!
Maya (devex): welcome aboard — closing this thread. :wave:
